in_marathi.name: Sukhbir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukhbir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sukhbir is derived from the Sanskrit words 'sukha' meaning happiness and 'bir' meaning warrior. It symbolizes a warrior who is blessed with happiness and prosperity.
